svg.title: PostgreSQL 17.11: median CSV import durations, two local runs
svg.desc: Logarithmic duration axis, lower is faster. Scriptella batch 1000 is 37.7 times faster than csvsql chunk 1000. Detailed report includes every individual value and unbatched cases.
